svg.text: Software product pipeline — three phases, artifact-driven, human at the irreversible gates
READY → copy features/_template/ → features/<slug>/ — the workspace ritual: every role knows where to read & write
feature PARKED — question to PO queue
regression → rollback (Rodin) · defect re-enters: code → implementer / plan → senior-developer
every step writes its artifact into features/<slug>/ — the folder is the audit trail:
brainstorming → online-research → edge-case-analysis → architecture-analysis → masterplan → implementation-plan → implementation.md (log + verdicts)
accepted findings become new feature-plan entries — the loop closes
RED LINES (no gate may waive): no new dependency without ADR · no PII/secrets in code or logs · no merge with red CI · agents never touch prod data
FOUNDATION — standing documents every role reads
stack · services · conventions · commands · red lines
problem · scope · depends-on · shared-work · PO queue
priorities · mandate: to PR-ready, never merge
RUNTIME (config, not process): factory.config.yaml + .env — sandbox: e2b · harness: claude-code (switch to pi = one config line) · model per role (default haiku) — see runtime-plan.md
